newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First, Labour cover "range of issues" - Clark.
newsitem.headline: NZ First, Labour cover "range of issues" - Clark.

text.p: New Zealand First and Labour negotiating teams covered a range of issues relating to "policy and process" in nearly two hours of coalition talks on Wednesday, Labour leader Helen Clark said.
She declined further comment on the substance of the talks.

New Zealand First, which holds the balance of power, also met the caretaker National Party government earlier on Wednesday and is due to hold more talks with both National and Labour on Thursday. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
